newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hutschenreuter expects greater loss in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hutschenreuter expects greater loss in 1996.

text.p: German porcelain maker Hutschenreuter AG said on Friday it expected losses this year to exceed its 1995 shortfall of almost 20 million marks.
The company will also close a plant in Hohenberg in 1997 as part of a "broad, basic reorganization", it said in a statement. The plant employs 100 workers.

Sales have fallen as a results of a downturn in the German construction industry, the company said. It reported a loss of 15.3 million marks in the first six months of 1996, with revenue falling eight percent to 161.7 million.
